note: Camping is allowed within 50 yards of five roadside parking lots, each a small gravel lot on a county road with no pads, tables or privy: two on road 925 south of Guier Lake (the west one at the gate of the shooting-range road), one on road 1000 on the east side, one on road 1075 on the north side, and one on Aria Lane in the separate tract north of the Blackwater River. A rig camps on the lot. The road 1075 lot sits at the edge of the waterfowl refuge, which is closed to all use October 15 to March 1; the other four are outside it. The 925 lots are the roomiest; the road 1000 one is little more than a gravel apron at a junction. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: MDC 'Individual Campsites' - the brochure allows camping 'within 50 yards of parking lots A, B, C, D and E only', the map draws five Primitive Camping symbols each beside a Parking Lot, and GIS has five points 30-55 m from five small roadside gravel lots. Free, FCFS, no hookups, 14-day limit. One of the five (road 1075) is at the waterfowl refuge edge; the pinned one is not. Pin is in timber 28 m from its lot. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION (lot rule - stays, but every spot is a roadside parking lot): the area page lists 'Camping: Individual Campsites'; the brochure lists 'Primitive Camping at Designated Sites' and says 'Camping is allowed within 50 yards of parking lots "A", "B", "C", "D" and "E" only. See map for locations. Camping on other parts of the area may be allowed by special use permit only.' The map (10/8/2019) does not letter the lots but draws five Primitive Camping symbols, each beside a Parking Lot symbol; GIS layer 27 has five 'Primitive Camping Area' points (OBJECTIDs 50, 51, 52, 53, 547). On the 180 m leaf-off frames each lot is a bare gravel pull-off beside the county road and each GIS point is 30-55 m off it in timber, brush or a tree planting with no clearing, pad or fire ring visible: road 1075 a gravel triangle about 15 m across; road 925 west about 25 x 20 m at the start of the range road; road 925 east a wedge about 20 x 30 m; road 1000 (the pin) an apron about 20 x 10 m at a road junction; Aria Ln about 25 x 20 m. MDC designates the camping (by lot, within 50 yards), so under the 2026-11-09 rule it stays, with the caveat that there is nothing but the lots. A 23-ft rig fits the 925 and Aria Ln lots; the road 1000 apron is marginal for anything but parking alongside.

WATERFOWL REFUGE vs EACH SPOT: the map's only hatching is 'Waterfowl Refuge (Closed to all use October 15 - March 1)' - there is no 'Waterfowl Hunting Only Zone' on this map. It covers Pool 2 and the ground west of it, from road 1075 south to the Blackwater River. On the 400-dpi crop the road 1075 Parking Lot and Primitive Camping symbols sit on the hatching's north edge, at the road, and that spot's GIS point (38.91132,-93.54414) is 55 m south-east of its lot, in timber on the refuge side beside a pool - so that one spot is at or inside the refuge edge and should be read as unusable October 15 to March 1. The two road 925 spots, the road 1000 spot (the pin) and the Aria Ln spot are all clear of the hatching. The brochure: 'Seasonal refuge is closed to all public use from October 15 to March 1'; the page's Rule 115: 'Portions of this department area are closed to protect waterfowl from October 15 through March 1'. Also from the brochure: 'Blackwater Road from the parking lot to the river access is closed from Oct. 15 to the close of the waterfowl season' (no camping spot is on it).

SEASON (manual, not overwritten): stored year_round true with the note 'Portions of the area are closed to protect waterfowl, October 15 through March 1.' The group is marked manual, so I left it. Suggested wording for the note: 'The camping spot on road 1075 is at the edge of the waterfowl refuge, closed to all use October 15 to March 1; the other four are outside it.' No other campsite season is given in the brochure.

CLUSTERS / TRACTS: four spots on the main (west/south) unit and one on the unit north of the Blackwater River. GIS points: 38.91132,-93.54414 (road 1075); 38.88957,-93.53864 and 38.88952,-93.53364 (road 925, 430 m apart); 38.89995,-93.50689 (road 1000, the pin); 38.94877,-93.46711 (Aria Ln, 6.4 km from the pin). No clear main camp; the nearest thing is the road 925 pair by Guier Lake and the range. Each is a single small lot, so no split.

PIN MOVE (small): stored 38.89995,-93.50689 is the GIS point, in closed timber 28 m north of its lot. Move onto the gravel apron at 38.89975,-93.50690 (GIS lot 1190 is 38.89970,-93.50687). If a roomier spot is wanted as the entry's pin, the road 925 west lot is at 38.88926,-93.53868 (GIS lot 1186).

ACCESS: 'West tract: from Concordia, take Highway 23 south 5 miles. East tract north of Blackwater River: from Concordia, take Highway 23 south approximately 4 miles, then east on NE 1200, area begins where NE 1200 turns north.' The camping lots are on county roads (gravel on imagery; road 1075 looks paved at its lot). No ford, low-water crossing, 4WD wording or posted limit on the page, brochure or map.
WATERFRONT (stored not waterfront - stands): no lot is at open water; the road 1075 one has a wetland pool about 60 m off through timber, inside the refuge.
PHONE: stored 660-530-5500 matches the area page ('For more information call (660) 530-5500').
